blocks.text: Anterior pituitary bohat se hormones chhorta hai, aur in mein se kai hormones doosre endocrine glands ke kaam ko qaboo karte hain:

items: Growth hormone (GH, ya somatotropin): muscles, haddiyon (bilwasta, yani indirectly) aur doosre tissues ki growth barhata hai. Yeh metabolism ko theek chalane ke liye bhi zaroori hai.

Adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH, ya corticotropin): adrenal cortex ko corticosteroids (zyada tar cortisol, aur thora aldosterone) chhorne par uksata hai, jo glucose aur namak ka homeostasis (andaruni tawazun) qaim rakhte hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Kitab ka bayan theek hai: cortisone aur aldosterone dono adrenal cortex ke corticosteroids hain. Mazeed (extra) baat: ACTH zyada tar cortisol (hydrocortisone) banwata hai; cortisone is ki ghair fa'al (inactive) shakal hai. Aldosterone par ACTH ka asar thora hai; aldosterone ko zyada tar gurdon ka renin-angiotensin nizam aur khoon ka K⁺ qaboo karta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text:
Growth hormone se ilaj
GH un bachon ko diya jata hai jin ka qad GH ki kami ki wajah se chhota ho. Is se un ki growth ki raftar behtar hoti hai.
Lekin har baune (chhote qad wale) shakhs mein GH ki kami nahin hoti, is liye GH therapy har kisi ke liye munasib nahin.
Kuch log GH is khayal se lete hain ke is se muscle banenge ya budhapa der se aayega, magar doctor in maqasid ke liye GH ke istemal ki himayat nahin karte.

items: Thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH, ya thyrotropin): thyroid gland se thyroxine banwata hai, aur thyroxine aage oxidative respiration (oxygen wali respiration) ko tez karta hai.
Luteinizing hormone (LH): auraton mein ovaries se progesterone aur estrogen banwata hai aur ovulation (ovary se anda nikalna) shuru karta hai. Mardon mein testes se testosterone banwata hai.

Follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH): auraton mein ovarian follicles ki nashonuma karta hai; mardon mein sperms ki nashonuma karta hai. FSH aur LH dono ko gonadotropins kehte hain (yani gonads par asar karne wale hormones).
Prolactin: mammary glands (chhati ke ghadood) se doodh banwata hai. Yeh mard aur aurat dono mein banta hai magar kaam sirf aurat mein karta hai.
